heading: Exclusive Federal jurisdiction
lead: The district courts of the United States shall have exclusive jurisdiction over an action brought under this chapter.

notes.text: Effective DateSection applicable to any pending case or any cause of action arising on or after 4 years before Oct. 29, 1992, see section 1003(c) of Pub. L. 102–572, set out as a note under section 2331 of this title.
